name: ripple
description: See what your changes reach: a map of everything that depends on your diff, drawn inside Claude Code

view.title: Default view
view.description: How the map is drawn when it opens: as a graph of boxes and links, or as a tree.

scroll.title: Graph scrolling
scroll.description: How a graph wider than the pane scrolls: pinned slides the long rows and keeps the ones that fit in view; sheet lays every row on one wide sheet and moves it whole.
